modules.title: Ideal gas: basic entropy and adiabatic relations
modules.doc:
In this module we formalize a simple thermodynamic model of a monophase
ideal gas. We:

* Define the entropy
    S(U,V,N) = N s₀ + N R (c \log(U/U₀) + \log(V/V₀) - (c+1)\log(N/N₀)),
* Prove equivalent formulations of the adiabatic relation for two states
  (U_a, V_a) and (U_b, V_b) at fixed N:

  1. c \log(U_a/U_b) + \log(V_a/V_b) = 0,
  2. (U_a/U_b)^c (V_a/V_b) = 1,
  3. U_a^c V_a = U_b^c V_b (the latter follows from (2)).

declarations.name: entropy
declarations.doc:
Entropy of a monophase ideal gas:
S(U,V,N) = N s0 + N R (c log(U/U0) + log(V/V0) - (c+1) log(N/N0)).
declarations.statement:
def entropy
    (c R s0 U0 V0 N0 : ℝ) (U V N : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: adiabatic_relation_log
declarations.doc:
Adiabatic relation in logarithmic form:
If S(Ua,Va,N) = S(Ub,Vb,N) with N fixed,
then c * log (Ua/Ub) + log (Va/Vb) = 0.
declarations.statement:
theorem adiabatic_relation_log
    {s0 U0 V0 N0 c R : ℝ}
    {Ua Ub Va Vb N : ℝ}
    (hUa : 0 < Ua) (hUb : 0 < Ub)
    (hVa : 0 < Va) (hVb : 0 < Vb)
    (hN : 0 < N)
    (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hV0 : 0 < V0)
    (hR : 0 < R)
    (hS :
      entropy c R s0 U0 V0 N0 Ua Va N =
      entropy c R s0 U0 V0 N0 Ub Vb N) :
    c * log (Ua / Ub) + log (Va / Vb) = 0

declarations.name: adiabatic_relation_UaUbVaVb
declarations.doc:
Adiabatic relation in product form:
If S(Ua,Va,N) = S(Ub,Vb,N) with N fixed,
then (Ua/Ub)^c * (Va/Vb) = 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem adiabatic_relation_UaUbVaVb
    {s0 U0 V0 N0 c R : ℝ}
    {Ua Ub Va Vb N : ℝ}
    (hUa : 0 < Ua) (hUb : 0 < Ub)
    (hVa : 0 < Va) (hVb : 0 < Vb)
    (hN : 0 < N)
    (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hV0 : 0 < V0)
    (hR : 0 < R)
    (hS :
      entropy c R s0 U0 V0 N0 Ua Va N =
      entropy c R s0 U0 V0 N0 Ub Vb N) :
    (Real.rpow (Ua / Ub) c) * (Va / Vb) = 1

modules.title: Temperature
modules.doc:
In this module we define the type `Temperature`, corresponding to the temperature in a given
(but arbitrary) set of units which have absolute zero at zero.

This is the version of temperature most often used in undergraduate and
non-mathematical physics.

The choice of units can be made on a case-by-case basis, as long as they are done consistently.

declarations.name: Temperature
declarations.doc:
The type `Temperature` represents the temperature in a given (but arbitrary) set of units
(preserving zero). It currently wraps `ℝ≥0`, i.e., absolute temperature in nonnegative reals.
declarations.statement:
structure Temperature where
  /-- The nonnegative real value of the temperature. -/
  val : ℝ≥0

declarations.doc: Coercion to `ℝ≥0`.
declarations.statement: instance : Coe Temperature ℝ≥0

declarations.name: Temperature.toReal
declarations.doc: The underlying real-number associated with the temperature.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def toReal (T : Temperature) : ℝ

declarations.doc: Coercion to `ℝ`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance : Coe Temperature ℝ

declarations.doc: Topology on `Temperature` induced from `ℝ≥0`.
declarations.statement: instance : TopologicalSpace Temperature
instance : Zero Temperature

declarations.name: Temperature.ext
declarations.statement: lemma ext {T₁ T₂ : Temperature} (h : T₁.val = T₂.val) : T₁ = T₂

declarations.name: Temperature.β
declarations.doc:
The inverse temperature defined as `1/(kB * T)` in a given, but arbitrary set of units.
This has the dimension of an inverse energy.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def β (T : Temperature) : ℝ≥0

declarations.name: Temperature.β_toReal
declarations.statement: lemma β_toReal (T : Temperature) : (β kB T : ℝ) = 1 / ((kB : ℝ) * (T : ℝ))

declarations.name: Temperature.ofβ
declarations.doc: The temperature associated with a given inverse temperature `β`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ofβ (β : ℝ≥0) : Temperature

declarations.name: Temperature.ofβ_eq
declarations.statement:
lemma ofβ_eq : ofβ kB = fun β => ⟨⟨1 / ((kB : ℝ) * β), by
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact zero_le_one
    · apply mul_nonneg
      · exact kB.val_nonneg
      · exact β.2⟩⟩

declarations.name: Temperature.β_ofβ
declarations.statement: lemma β_ofβ (β' : ℝ≥0) : β kB (ofβ kB β') = β'

declarations.name: Temperature.ofβ_toReal
declarations.statement: lemma ofβ_toReal (β : ℝ≥0) : (ofβ kB β).toReal = 1 / ((kB : ℝ) * (β : ℝ))

declarations.name: Temperature.ofβ_β
declarations.statement: lemma ofβ_β (T : Temperature) : ofβ kB (β kB T) = T

declarations.name: Temperature.beta_pos
declarations.doc: Positivity of `β` from positivity of temperature.
declarations.statement: lemma beta_pos (T : Temperature) (hT_pos : 0 < T.val) : 0 < (T.β kB : ℝ)

declarations.name: Temperature.ofβ_continuousOn
declarations.statement: lemma ofβ_continuousOn : ContinuousOn (ofβ kB : ℝ≥0 → Temperature) (Set.Ioi 0)

declarations.name: Temperature.ofβ_differentiableOn
declarations.statement:
lemma ofβ_differentiableOn :
    DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun (x : ℝ) => ((ofβ kB (Real.toNNReal x)).val : ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0)

declarations.name: Temperature.eventually_pos_ofβ
declarations.doc: Eventually, `ofβ β` is positive as β → ∞`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eventually_pos_ofβ :
    ∀ᶠ b : ℝ≥0 in atTop, ((Temperature.ofβ kB b : Temperature) : ℝ) > 0

declarations.name: Temperature.tendsto_toReal_ofβ_atTop
declarations.doc: Core convergence: as β → ∞, `toReal (ofβ β) → 0` in `ℝ`.
declarations.statement:
lemma tendsto_toReal_ofβ_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun b : ℝ≥0 => (Temperature.ofβ kB b : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ))

declarations.name: Temperature.tendsto_ofβ_atTop
declarations.doc: As β → ∞, T = ofβ β → 0+ in ℝ (within Ioi 0).
declarations.statement:
lemma tendsto_ofβ_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun b : ℝ≥0 => (Temperature.ofβ kB b : ℝ))
      atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))

declarations.name: Temperature.ofNNReal
declarations.doc: Build a `Temperature` directly from a nonnegative real.
declarations.statement: def ofNNReal (t : ℝ≥0) : Temperature

declarations.name: Temperature.ofNNReal_val
declarations.statement: lemma ofNNReal_val (t : ℝ≥0) : (ofNNReal t).val = t

declarations.name: Temperature.coe_ofNNReal_coe
declarations.statement: lemma coe_ofNNReal_coe (t : ℝ≥0) : ((ofNNReal t : Temperature) : ℝ≥0) = t

declarations.name: Temperature.coe_ofNNReal_real
declarations.statement: lemma coe_ofNNReal_real (t : ℝ≥0) : ((⟨t⟩ : Temperature) : ℝ) = t

declarations.name: Temperature.ofRealNonneg
declarations.doc: Convenience: build a temperature from a real together with a proof of nonnegativity.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ofRealNonneg (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Temperature

declarations.name: Temperature.ofRealNonneg_val
declarations.statement:
lemma ofRealNonneg_val {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (ofRealNonneg t ht).val = ⟨t, ht⟩

declarations.name: Temperature.betaFromReal
declarations.doc:
Map a real `t` to the inverse temperature `β` corresponding to the temperature `Real.toNNReal t`
(`max t 0`), returned as a real number.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def betaFromReal (t : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: Temperature.beta_fun_T_formula
declarations.doc: Explicit closed-form for `Beta_fun_T t` when `t > 0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma beta_fun_T_formula (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    betaFromReal kB t = 1 / ((kB : ℝ) * t)

declarations.name: Temperature.beta_fun_T_eq_on_Ioi
declarations.doc: On `Ioi 0`, `Beta_fun_T t` equals `1 / (kB * t)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma beta_fun_T_eq_on_Ioi :
    EqOn (betaFromReal kB) (fun t : ℝ => 1 / ((kB : ℝ) * t)) (Set.Ioi 0)

declarations.name: Temperature.deriv_beta_wrt_T
declarations.statement:
lemma deriv_beta_wrt_T (T : Temperature) (hT_pos : 0 < T.val) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (betaFromReal kB) (-1 / ((kB : ℝ) * (T.val : ℝ)^2)) (Set.Ioi 0)
      (T.val : ℝ)

declarations.name: Temperature.chain_rule_T_beta
declarations.doc: Chain rule for β(T) : d/dT F(β(T)) = F'(β(T)) * (-1 / (kB * T^2)), within `Ioi 0`.
declarations.statement:
lemma chain_rule_T_beta {F : ℝ → ℝ} {F' : ℝ}
    (T : Temperature) (hT_pos : 0 < T.val)
    (hF_deriv : HasDerivWithinAt F F' (Set.Ioi 0) (T.β kB : ℝ)) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun t : ℝ => F (betaFromReal kB t))
      (F' * (-1 / ((kB : ℝ) * (T.val : ℝ)^2))) (Set.Ioi 0) (T.val : ℝ)

modules.title: Units on Temperature
modules.doc:
A unit of temperature corresponds to a choice of translationally-invariant
metric on the temperature manifold (to be defined diffeomorphic to `ℝ≥0`).
Such a choice is (non-canonically) equivalent to a
choice of positive real number. We define the type `TemperatureUnit` to be equivalent to the
positive reals.

On `TemperatureUnit` there is an instance of division giving a real number, corresponding to the
ratio of the two scales of temperature unit.

To define specific temperature units, we first state the existence of a
a given temperature unit, and then construct all other temperature units from it.
We choose to state the
existence of the temperature unit of kelvin, and construct all other temperature units from that.

sections.text:
## Specific choices of temperature units

To define a specific temperature units.
We first define the notion of a kelvin to correspond to the temperature unit with underlying value
equal to `1`. This is really down to a choice in the isomorphism between the set of metrics
on the temperature manifold and the positive reals.

Once we have defined kelvin, we can define other temperature units by scaling kelvin.

declarations.name: TemperatureUnit
declarations.doc:
The choices of translationally-invariant metrics on the temperature-manifold.
Such a choice corresponds to a choice of units for temperature.
declarations.statement:
structure TemperatureUnit where
  /-- The underlying scale of the unit. -/
  val : ℝ
  property : 0 < val
instance : PositiveRealUnitCore TemperatureUnit

declarations.name: TemperatureUnit.kelvin
declarations.doc: The definition of a temperature unit of kelvin.
declarations.statement: def kelvin : TemperatureUnit

declarations.name: TemperatureUnit.nanokelvin
declarations.doc: The temperature unit of degrees nanokelvin (10^(-9) kelvin).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def nanokelvin : TemperatureUnit

declarations.name: TemperatureUnit.microkelvin
declarations.doc: The temperature unit of degrees microkelvin (10^(-6) kelvin).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def microkelvin : TemperatureUnit

declarations.name: TemperatureUnit.millikelvin
declarations.doc: The temperature unit of degrees millikelvin (10^(-3) kelvin).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def millikelvin : TemperatureUnit

declarations.name: TemperatureUnit.absoluteFahrenheit
declarations.doc:
The temperature unit of degrees fahrenheit ((5/9) of a kelvin).
Note, this is fahrenheit starting at `0` absolute temperature.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def absoluteFahrenheit : TemperatureUnit
